description:
🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:

  • Be a Champion Team

  • Prioritize Ruthlessly

  • Ship fast, Quality Follows

  • Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

About the Role

Somewhere right now, a motion designer is posting a transition so smooth that half the internet will try to copy it by Friday. An AI artist is shipping a caption style nobody has seen before. Most of them do it alone, for likes and the occasional course sale.

We want them earning from that work every day, with us.

You’ll build OpusClip’s creative community: the best creative technologists, motion designers, AI artists, and video editors out there. OpusClip is an AI video editor with 20 million users. Your community’s editing styles and motion ship inside OpusClip and AI Producer and reach every one of those creators, plus the AI agents working for them. Every time someone uses their work, they get paid.

The work we’re after is hand-crafted, as smooth as After Effects, with no AI look. It’s hard to copy and it goes stale fast, so the people behind it matter more than any single preset. You’ll be their agent: find them, earn their trust, and help them build a real business with us. You’ll also be the one who decides what ships.

You’ll start as a team of one, close to the work, working directly with our founders.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Bring in the best. Start invite-only with top independent creatives on X, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, beginning with those who already sell courses or templates. Then open the doors to power users already building in AI Producer, the way Notion users sell templates.

  • Make it worth their while. Set up revenue share, licensing, and monthly payouts with finance and legal. Run themed challenges around what the product needs next, with a prize pool split by how often each preset gets used. Creatives who also promote OpusClip through our creator partnerships team can earn on both sides.

  • Guard the bar. Write the rubric (pacing, hooks, captions, motion, no AI look), run every submission yourself and score it, give feedback people actually use, and decide what ships. Work with engineers and our creative technologists to get it live in the product.

  • Keep it fresh. Ship around 50 new presets a month across categories, timed to seasons, holidays, and regions. New presets launch as paid, older ones move to free, and stale ones retire.

  • Bring the community to life. Discord, tutorials, and regular sessions with our most active users. Carry what you hear into the roadmap, from submission and preview tools to usage tracking, and match creatives with brands that want work in their own style.

  • Own the numbers. Creatives signed, presets live, usage, revenue, and what our creatives earn. Share them weekly and double down on what works.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Taste in video and motion. You can tell great from merely good in seconds, and say why. You’re hands-on enough with AI tools to run any preset yourself and score it.

  • A creative community or marketplace you’ve grown, at a place like TikTok Effect House, CapCut, Canva, Motion Array, or Envato, a creator fund, or a talent network. Supply went up and quality held.

  • Roots in the AI creative scene. You know who’s making the most exciting AI video and motion work right now, and plenty of them would answer your DM.

  • Deal-making with a long memory. You’ve signed independent creatives and kept them happy long after the contract.

  • An AI-native operator. Agents handle your outreach, review, and reporting, so you can run a big network on your own.

  • Bonus: hands-on editing or motion experience; an audience of your own; experience with licensing or creator payouts; fluency in Chinese or another major creative market.

 

How to Apply

  • A community or marketplace you grew, and the numbers behind it.

  • Your social profile or portfolio, if you have one.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape a new creative economy for the AI era, from day one.

  • Full-time, based in North America, close to the creators you’ll work with. Immediate, visible impact at a fast-moving, globally recognized AI company.

 

EEO

OpusClip is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. OpusClip considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Opus Clip is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.
